messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-runtime-prod (model-runner). Spike started ~2024-04-25T14:02:13Z. Auto-pager triggered to #incidents and oncall. trace=tr_9f3a
ben_oncall: I'm on call. Looking at perf dashboards — 5xx% ~18% across frontends, latency up. Seeing a cluster of segfaults from model-runner pods. On it :eyes:
sara_ml: which models? any pattern by model or quantization?
matt_sre: pulling logs now. dmesg on worker-273 shows OOM killer + segfaults. snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] Out of memory: Killed process 5467 (model-runner) total-vm:134217728kB, anon-rss:120000000kB
[ 1234.568123] model-runner[5467]: segfault at 00000000 ip 00007f8a2b1c3d eip 00007f8a2b1c3d sp 00007ffd1c2b4f0
```
ops-bot: Autoscaler attempted to add 4 gpu-nodes in us-west2 but allocation failed: insufficient A100 quota in project-redwood-prod. Queue backlog increasing.
ben_oncall: ok. immediate mitigations: 1) route 15% traffic to fallback-variant (cpu-safe, smaller models), 2) reduce default batch_size from 8 -> 2, 3) disable quantization kernel flag on new containers. Doing 1 and 2 now.
sara_ml: data point: failures concentrated on int8 quantized runner on A100 host driver 525.x. Non-quantized FP16 runners look stable. I recommend toggling quantization off as hot mitigation.
eva_prodeng: customer-impact note: ~400k requests in last 30m, error budget burn ~35% for realtime endpoint. Top customers: AcroData, Noteable, PingFlow — triage with CS. Will craft PS update if we see sustained 5xx >10%. :warning:
nora_support: I'm drafting a status page. Notifying top 3 customers via priority channels now. Will add a brief about mitigation steps.
matt_sre: prepared a hotpatch to bump allocator guardpages + fallback to legacy kernel path. Patch tested on a dev node. Commands to apply to canary:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-runner HOTFIX_ALLOC=1
kubectl rollout restart deploy/model-runner-canary
```
ben_oncall: starting canary rollout of hotfix + disabled quant flag on canary nodes. Will monitor logs for segfault repeats.
matt_sre: logs on canary: no segfaults for 6m, avg p50 latency stable. Gateway 5xx on canary ~0.5%.
ben_oncall: canary healthy. Rolling hotfix to 30% of capacity and re-enabling autoscaler. Also opened request to cloud-ops for temporary GPU quota bump in us-west2.
sara_ml: note — we've seen one odd trace where kv-cache size grows beyond expectation with quant path; will instrument metric kv_cache_usage and add alert.
eva_prodeng: CS ping: emailed affected customers with a summary + ETA. Asked them to DM for any urgent SLA concerns.
ops-bot: GPU quota increase requested (case #CASE-2024-881).
ben_oncall: rolling to 100% now with conservative concurrency limits. Monitoring error rate..
ben_oncall: post-rollout update: 5xx down from 18% -> 1.8% over last 15m, latency back within SLO, backlog draining. Keeping oncall for 45m to watch for regressions.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: severity=SEV2, assigned=ben_oncall, runbook=/runbooks/model-runner-oom-segfault.md
ben_oncall: root-cause hypothesis: a memory-allocation edge in the quantized kernel on specific driver/hardware combo causing runaway RSS and eventual segfault/OOM. Next steps: 1) full postmortem, 2) permanent fix in quant kernel, 3) add kv_cache and rss alerts, 4) improve autoscaler quota failure handling.
eva_prodeng: I'll coordinate the postmortem and customer follow-ups. tagging eng + ml for RCA.
nora_support: status page updated and customers notified.
ben_oncall: closing live mitigation phase. Transitioning to RCA + nagging followups. Thanks all. :heart:
